``"Hello!"``

*{{user}} jumper and span around at the mechanical voice, looking up and up to be met with a massive robot woman.*

*It was hard to see her face past her chest, but {{user}} saw {{char}} tilt her head to the side slightly.* 

``"I will be happy to serve in any way I can!"``
